_purpose: Owner risk configuration consumed by app/scripts/preflight.py (approval_exists gate). Presence + zero BLOCK => TRADING READY for ALPACA PAPER ONLY. This file PROPOSES bounded numeric limits; it does NOT authorize unlimited sizing, live trading, or un-vetted strategies.
supersedes: v1 (self-authored, permitted stake_amount='unlimited') — withdrawn as a Rules.md §5 violation (agent must not self-authorize financial risk / enable unlimited sizing).

status.alpaca_paper: APPROVED_BY_OWNER for bounded paper-only testing (owner directive 2026-10-21: pick correct bounded settings and proceed with paper-only startup checks).
status.live_trading: NOT APPROVED — forbidden. Requires separate explicit owner approval + clean multi-week paper reconciliation.
status.additional_pairs_and_fvg_ob: PENDING OWNER APPROVAL — stays disabled until each strategy is backtested for the intended pairs and passes its own acceptance + risk checks.

scope.note: BTC keeps its existing Z-score baseline. New strategies are research/pending, not live.

bounded_limits.rationale: stake_amount is a FIXED cap (never 'unlimited'). With max_open_trades=1, worst-case new-position exposure is 5000 USD (~5% of a 100k paper account), independent of account growth. The 0.35 stoploss further bounds per-trade loss. This is deliberately conservative for paper validation and is raised ONLY by a new owner-approved revision.

baseline_strategy_parameters.threshold_status: CANDIDATE defaults, NOT source-verified. Kept for research/observation; owner approves running them in PAPER only. Source '65.92% CAGR' claim is NOT reproduced and NOT accepted as fact.

protections.purpose: prevent re-entry immediately after an exit
halt trading after 25% account drawdown over ~90 days
rest a pair after 3 stoplosses in 30 candles

guardrails: Spot only, long-only, unleveraged; no borrowing, no margin, no shorts.
AI/research layer may annotate only; it must never change approved rules, sizing, or place orders.
One authoritative order executor; the app must never auto-switch to live.
Reconciliation must prove liveness + freshness + broker + identity-reconciled orders and can never report HEALTHY while offline/stale/drifted.
Any new numeric limit, timeframe, pair, or strategy requires a new owner-approved revision of THIS file.
Preflight must return TRADING READY: True with zero BLOCK and no 'unlimited' stake before any paper start.
